title: Relative closedness of {Θ ≥ α} and M_V = spt V ∩ U under θ ≥ α (Simon 3.13, 4.10(1))
statement: Assume ApproxTangentAE. Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 0, V a rectifiable n-varifold in ℝ^{n+ℓ}, and U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open. Write Θ = V.density, μ_V = V.weight and M_V = V.canonicalCarrier U = {x ∈ U : Θ(x) > 0}. Suppose V.HasDensityAt ξ (Θ(ξ)) for every ξ ∈ U and Θ is upper semicontinuous on U. Then (iii) for every α > 0 there is a closed set C ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with {x ∈ M_V : α ≤ Θ(x)} = C ∩ U. And (iv) for every α > 0 with V.MultiplicityGE α U (some admissible pair (M, θ) with mk (M, θ) = V has α ≤ θ Hⁿ-a.e. on M ∩ U), M_V = spt V ∩ U, where spt V is the support of μ_V, and α ≤ Θ(x) for every x ∈ M_V.
lean_statement: ApproxTangentAE → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → IsOpen U → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) → UpperSemicontinuousOn V.density U → (∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → ∃ C, IsClosed C ∧ {x | x ∈ V.canonicalCarrier U ∧ α ≤ V.density x} = C ∩ U) ∧ ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → V.MultiplicityGE α U → V.canonicalCarrier U = V.support ∩ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ V.canonicalCarrier U, α ≤ V.density x
